description: High and low tides with heights, in the station's local time. Up to 7 days ahead free; longer ranges (up to 90 days) need the user's Coast Map Pass key.

days.description: Days to cover, starting today at the station (default 2). Up to 7 free; up to 90 with a Coast Map Pass key.

from.description: First day as YYYY-MM-DD in the station's time zone (default today). Free keys reach 7 days ahead of today.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative west of Greenwich.

station.description: Station code from find_stations (e.g. "07795" for Victoria Harbour, "9447130" for Seattle). Give this or lat/lng.

name: tide_times
title: High and low tide times
